## File: huggingface_transformers/tests/models/lightglue/test_image_processing_lightglue.py

Prompts

```
['run the LightGlueImageProcessingTest unittest suite to verify image processor behavior', 'create a fake LightGlueKeypointMatchingOutput with random matches between 50 keypoints per image', 'create a random numpy array of integers between 0 and 254 with a given size', 'create a random PyTorch tensor with uniform values between 0 and 1', 'review the LightGlueImageProcessingTester class that extends SuperGlueImageProcessingTester for keypoint matching tests', 'test the LightGlueForKeypointMatching model by running forward pass and verifying output tensor shapes', 'test the LightGlueConfig class by creating configs with custom keypoint detector and matching parameters', 'run LightGlue model inference on image pairs with early stopping enabled and verify match counts', 'run LightGlue model inference with depth confidence set to 1.0 to disable early stopping', 'test that LightGlue model produces equivalent results when processing images in batches versus individually']
```
